name: Aljunied
summary: NEL heartland stop between Paya Lebar and Kallang — mature HDB density, practical rents, and shorter CBD hops than Hougang without PLQ condo premiums.
body: Aljunied is the northeast/east shortlist when someone wants North-East Line access and heartland errands without paying Paya Lebar Quarter rents. Mature HDB blocks dominate; condo inserts appear toward Geylang and Paya Lebar edges. Expats land here for NEL CBD hops and value; walk evening corridor life and check estate variance before LOI. Compare with Mountbatten when CCL + food/stadium lifestyle matters more, Nicoll Highway for condo/park-connector living, and Eunos for a calmer EWL heartland alternative.
bestFor: NEL CBD hoppers wanting heartland rents
car-light households okay with estate variance
expats testing east-central before outer towns
watchOuts: Geylang-edge texture if you stretch too far
HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval checks
